long_description:
# Suumo Japan Real Estate Price Stats API (MCP Server)

MCP server wrapping the RapidAPI Suumo Japan Real Estate Price Stats API service.

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `get_api_info()` | Metadata, RapidAPI URL, pricing tier, integration notes |
| `query_api(params)` | Call the RapidAPI endpoint (requires `RAPIDAPI_KEY` env) |

## Data Source

- **RapidAPI**: https://rapidapi.com/atsushi-noriduki/api/japan-suumo
- **Apify Store**: https://apify.com/fruitful_quintessence (related actors for broader coverage)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/atushi1841/japan-suumo-mcp

## Pricing

This API is **FREEMIUM** on RapidAPI — free tier available without credit card.
Get your free key at the RapidAPI URL above.

## Requirements

- Python >= 3.10, fastmcp
- Optional: `RAPIDAPI_KEY` env var for actual data calls (free)
- Local stdio MCP transport

## Installation (Smithery)

```bash
smithery install @atushi1841/japan-suumo-mcp
```
